text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Japanese Derby, and
Tokyo
Racecourse is getting really
heated up.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
She's number one in the popularity ranks
for a reason! She's on a winning streak of
graded races,
so I think she's definitely
got this!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Oh, you sweet summer child. Trying to follow in your parents' footsteps is a huuuge motivator! That's why my favorite's going to win!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Wow.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I can really feel how much everyone
cares about
the runners they're cheering
for.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's right... Flash was saying that it's
special. I
guess this is what she meant.
choice_data_list: The Derby is also a 'dream' for th...

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Hey, darling.
Why isn't this "Eishin Flash"

popular? She's really good, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Because the other runners are much better,
honey. There's no denying that
she's good, but she's got no hope
against this competition. For
example...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Go, Flash! You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, once the race starts, everyone's
expectations are turned on
their heads. The runner who breaks
through the chaos of the homestretch is
none other than...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's Eishin Flash! Eishin Flash has taken
the lead!
She's holding onto it, aaand...
she crosses the
finish line!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Carrying the cheers of thousands, this
year's
Derby Champion is... Eishin Flash!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo! Eishin Flaaasssh!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: That was... amazing...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from the race, I grow a
little
concerned with how quiet Curren
Chan is, so we
stop by a park.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...I've been working so hard on my social
media
presence lately that you've been
worried about
me, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...I've been working so hard on my social
media
presence lately that you've been
worried about
me, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'm okay. Really. The truth is, I was
feeling a tiny
bit... insecure... I guess.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if it's really a good idea to
just focus on sprints. Like, I won't get
much attention unless
I do a lot of extra
work outside of racing...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Basically, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I understand her concerns. Even if there
are some
popular and exciting sprints...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Compared to the Classic races like the
Triple Crown tour, they don't get much
media coverage, and they don't get
anywhere near the same attention from
fans either.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's why I was thinking...
If I can stand out a
whole bunch, it'd be good
promotion for the
races.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I figured if I could charm people with my
cuteness and get them hooked on
watching my races,
everything would be
solved just like that! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But, of course, it's not that easy. I saw
that at
today's race.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I can never draw that amount of passion
from
people the way I am now.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Flash had such a pure smile on her face
today... It
was beyond cute.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That smile resonated with me. It was just
like the
shock I felt the first time I
watched a race.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I want that kind of passion, and to find my cuteness at its end.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But... does my running linger in people's
hearts
like what we saw today?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
At the very least... it doesn't linger in
mine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She speaks firmly, and I can see
frustration
seeping into her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
With the way things are now, no matter
how many people watch my races, I'm
never gonna be the
most beloved
runner.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I have to change. I have to be... the
cutest me I
can be!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At this point, it's not possible to frame
what
Curren Chan wants in terms of an
actual goal...
But one thing's for sure...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash won and proved herself to
everyone.
Only winners are worthy of
calling themselves the
best.
choice_data_list: Then we've just got to get stronger.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...You're right.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Okay. Then, I'm gonna get stronger!
Let's hit the
track!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Okay. Then, I'm gonna get stronger!
Let's hit the
track!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta push myself to the very
limit if
I'm
gonna get stronger. I need to train!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her phrasing makes me think of
something.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Really?!
choice_data_list: Then I've got the perfect training...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's almost summer. The Classics are over
for the
time being, and it's the season
for runners to work
on improvement.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Ahhh. So we take advantage of the
time when everyone's exposure is
relatively low to run races
and build
experience, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Okay, sure! This summer, I'm getting
even cuter!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, we set our next goal as
the first
race of the Summer Sprint
Series—the Hakodate
Sprint Stakes!
choice_data_list: First up is the Hakodate Sprint St...
First up, the Hakodate Sprint Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's decided, then! We're going to
Hakodate for my special
training—Operation "Eat Seafood Till

You Drop"!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Just kidding. Ehe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait. One day, everything I ever

wanted... will be mine!
